verdict.rationale: E2B documents running terminal commands in the sandbox via `commands.run()`, an `exec` CLI command with background mode, and interactive terminals. It also describes a real Debian toolchain with full terminal access and outbound internet by default, and templates can bake in install commands, so arbitrary shell use and package installation are clearly supported. Missing for 10: no explicit doc showing runtime package installation (e.g. pip/apt inside a running sandbox), and no independent hands-on corroboration of shell or package workflows.
